items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Yeah Cannonball and Bird. ... I remember it as a CD or record, whatever, where he did play Selmer for a while.

ctx.x: Yeah Cannonball and Bird. Yeah. And it’s a very nice horn, it’s very human-like. Very much like the human voice.

It’s interesting you say that because when I hear your tone, I mean I like — actually the thing that attracts me to a player is the tone first. And I hear that in your sound. And I noticed when Cannonball switched from King to Selmer I think that I was disappointed.
